metadata.description: Hardware-related software, utilities, drivers, and management tools.

data.name: NVIDIA App
data.purpose: Manage NVIDIA graphics drivers, settings, and features

data.name: AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition
data.purpose: Manage Radeon drivers, gaming settings, and performance

data.name: AMD Ryzen Master
data.purpose: Monitor and tune supported Ryzen processors
data.notes: CPU tuning can affect stability and warranty.

data.name: Intel Extreme Tuning Utility
data.purpose: Monitor and tune supported Intel processors
data.notes: Support varies by CPU and platform.

data.name: Intel Driver & Support Assistant
data.purpose: Identify Intel hardware and find driver updates

data.name: CPU-Z
data.purpose: Identify CPU, motherboard, memory, and system details

data.name: HWiNFO
data.purpose: Detailed hardware information and sensor monitoring
data.notes: One of the broadest Windows hardware monitoring tools.

data.name: HWMonitor
data.purpose: Monitor temperatures, voltages, fan speeds, and power

data.name: MSI Afterburner
data.purpose: GPU monitoring, tuning, and fan control
data.notes: Widely used regardless of GPU brand.

data.name: EVGA Precision X1
data.purpose: Tune and monitor NVIDIA graphics cards
data.notes: Best known for EVGA graphics cards but can support other hardware depending on version.

data.name: ASUS GPU Tweak III
data.purpose: Tune and monitor ASUS and compatible GPUs

data.name: Gigabyte Control Center
data.purpose: Manage supported GIGABYTE hardware and features

data.name: MSI Center
data.purpose: Manage MSI motherboards, laptops, and peripherals

data.name: ASUS Armoury Crate
data.purpose: Manage ASUS hardware, RGB, drivers, and performance

data.name: G-Helper
data.purpose: Lightweight control utility for ASUS ROG laptops
data.notes: Community utility focused on lower overhead.

data.name: OpenRGB
data.purpose: Control RGB lighting across multiple hardware vendors

data.name: SignalRGB
data.purpose: Synchronize RGB lighting across compatible devices

data.name: CrystalDiskInfo
data.purpose: Monitor HDD and SSD health information

data.name: WD Dashboard
data.purpose: Manage Western Digital and SanDisk drives
data.notes: Drive support depends on product family.

data.name: SeaTools
data.purpose: Diagnose Seagate and compatible storage devices

data.name: smartmontools
data.purpose: Access SMART data and perform drive diagnostics

data.name: OCCT
data.purpose: Stress-test CPU, GPU, memory, and power subsystems

data.name: Prime95
data.purpose: Perform CPU torture testing and distributed prime calculations

data.name: Blender Benchmark
data.purpose: Benchmark CPU and GPU rendering performance

data.name: Intel Graphics Command Center
data.purpose: Configure Intel integrated and Arc graphics

data.name: Intel Unison
data.purpose: Connect compatible PCs and mobile devices
data.notes: Not a hardware tuning utility but associated with PC connectivity.

data.name: AMD Adrenalin Auto-Detect and Install Tool
data.purpose: Detect Radeon hardware and install drivers

data.name: NVIDIA Nsight Systems
required_permissions: Administrator may be needed for tracing

data.name: AMD ROCm
data.purpose: GPU compute platform and developer stack
data.license: ROCm open-source components with varied licenses

data.name: Vulkan SDK
data.notes: Developer toolkit rather than end-user utility.

data.name: Windows Device Manager
data.purpose: View and manage hardware devices and drivers

data.name: dxdiag
data.purpose: Inspect DirectX, graphics, and audio configuration

data.name: Task Manager
data.purpose: Monitor CPU, memory, GPU, storage, and processes

data.name: Autoruns
data.purpose: Inspect programs and drivers launched automatically
data.notes: Useful for troubleshooting startup and driver loading.

data.name: USB Device Tree Viewer
data.purpose: Inspect USB topology, devices, and descriptors

data.name: NetworkMiner
data.purpose: Analyze captured network traffic and hosts

data.name: tcpdump
data.purpose: Capture and inspect network packets from command line

data.name: Etcher
data.purpose: Write disk images to removable media

data.name: Ventoy
data.purpose: Boot multiple ISO files from one USB drive

data.name: GNOME Disks
data.purpose: Manage disks, partitions, and SMART data

data.name: smartctl
data.purpose: Query SMART health and drive diagnostics

data.name: HD Tune
data.notes: Legacy but still used storage utility.

data.name: HDTune Pro
data.notes: Paid expanded version of HD Tune.

data.name: ThrottleStop
data.purpose: Tune and monitor supported Intel mobile CPUs
data.notes: Unofficial advanced Intel mobile tuning utility.

data.name: Ryzen Controller
data.purpose: Tune thermal and power limits on supported Ryzen mobile CPUs

data.name: Latencymon
data.purpose: Analyze DPC and ISR latency for realtime workloads
data.notes: Useful for audio and realtime troubleshooting.

data.name: lm-sensors
data.notes: Foundation for many Linux sensor tools.

data.name: nvtop
data.purpose: Monitor GPU usage on Linux terminals
required_permissions: Standard user; root for some metrics
data.notes: Terminal GPU monitor with vendor support.

data.name: nvidia-smi
data.purpose: Inspect and manage NVIDIA GPU state

data.name: radeontop
data.purpose: Monitor AMD GPU utilization on Linux

data.name: rocm-smi
data.purpose: Monitor AMD Instinct GPU state on Linux
data.notes: ROC-smi utility for supported AMD accelerators.

data.name: Hardinfo2
data.purpose: Display Linux hardware and benchmark information

data.name: Dmesg
required_permissions: Root or kernel access restrictions vary

data.name: Razer Synapse
data.purpose: Manage Razer keyboards, mice, headsets, and lighting

data.name: Voicemeeter
data.purpose: Manage virtual audio routing and mixing

data.name: Display Driver Uninstaller
data.notes: Usually run before installing a fresh graphics driver.

data.name: AMD Cleanup Utility
data.purpose: Remove AMD graphics and chipset software

data.name: NVIDIA Cleanup Tool
data.purpose: Clean NVIDIA driver components during troubleshooting
data.notes: Use availability varies by NVIDIA support workflow.

data.name: Raspberry Pi Imager
data.purpose: Write OS images to Raspberry Pi boot media

data.name: ASRock Polychrome RGB
data.purpose: Control RGB lighting on ASRock hardware
